blur.fallbackApi: 28–30: same tint, sheen and rim without BlurEffect

evidence.authority: Code-led native Android Operate; user explicitly pinned Liquid Glass. No approved HTML comp or web detector is asserted.
evidence.verification: Independent finish reviewer issued ship for Appearance after opening all 17 required versionCode 10 PNGs: 13 actual MainActivity theme captures and four language captures. Theme captures include actual OS night mode, 1.5× font scale, tablet, landscape and a declared scrolled companion. English/Italian language captures use MainActivity with Dark default; dark/large-type language captures are synthetic Compose fixtures. The 35-record master manifest has mixed per-file versions, retaining source-composer/Native versionCode 8 references; this review does not certify all 35 as current or visually rereviewed.
limitations: Current redesign evidence is emulator-only; some captures are explicitly synthetic fixtures.
Physical OPPO/LG playback, motion and GPU/gesture performance are not established for this redesign.
API 28–30 no-blur fallback is implemented but its appearance has not been captured.
No new shipping product raster; original beaver vector and vector UI icons retained.
evidence.nativeQualityRegression: Earlier, separately reported real-engine DLNA regression: FFprobe measured 1440-pixel output from a 1440-pixel source for Native quality at the simulated receiver. The Appearance visual reviewer did not rerun this regression; it is not physical-TV proof or a full instrumentation-suite result.
evidence.validation: Reported 17 selected instrumentation tests, 10 JVM tests, lint zero errors/10 warnings; full 23-test instrumentation suite not run. Theme tests cover Dark fallback, persistence/reopen, overrides, System changes, draft retention and synthetic active-model preservation. Separate real-engine DLNA language-change/Stop fixture passed; no physical OPPO/LG or GPU verification.

appAppearance.application: MainActivity remembers the saved enum and updates Compose state immediately without Activity recreation; the draft, current model and running casting service are preserved.

fun GlassPanel(

  onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null,
  content: @Composable () -> Unit,
) {
  val material = modifier.glassMaterial()
  if (onClick == null)
    Surface(
      modifier = material,
      color = Color.Transparent,
      contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
      content = content,

  else
    Surface(

      modifier = material,
      color = Color.Transparent,
      contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
      content = content,
    )
}

private fun ActiveCast(phase: CastPhase, url: String, tv: SavedTv?) {
  val (title, help) =
    when (phase) {
      CastPhase.Extracting -> R.string.phase_extracting to R.string.phase_extracting_help
      CastPhase.Measuring -> R.string.phase_measuring to R.string.phase_measuring_help
      CastPhase.Casting -> R.string.phase_casting to R.string.phase_casting_help
      CastPhase.Failed -> R.string.phase_failed to R.string.phase_failed_help
      else -> R.string.phase_connecting to R.string.phase_connecting_help
    }
  Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(24.dp)) {
    Text(
      stringResource(title),
      style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineLarge,
      modifier =
        Modifier.semantics {
          heading()
          liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite
        },
    )
    Text(stringResource(help), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
    GlassPanel {
      Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(28.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(18.dp),
      ) {
        CastIcon(R.drawable.ic_cast)
        Text(
          tv?.name ?: stringResource(R.string.current_tv),
          style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
        )
        tv?.let { Text(protocolName(it.type), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium) }
        HorizontalDivider(color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
        Text(
          runCatching { java.net.URI(url).host }.getOrNull()
            ?: stringResource(R.string.video_source),
          style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
        )
      }
    }
    if (phase != CastPhase.Casting && phase != CastPhase.Failed)
      LinearProgressIndicator(Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
  }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
internal fun PlaybackSettings(
  initialHeight: String,
  initialSubtitles: String,
  dismiss: () -> Unit,
  save: (String, String) -> Unit,
) {
  val presets = listOf("720", "1080", "2160")
  var height by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(initialHeight) }
  var custom by rememberSaveable {
    mutableStateOf(initialHeight !in presets && initialHeight != NATIVE_QUALITY)
  }
  var subtitleMode by rememberSaveable {
    mutableStateOf(if (initialSubtitles in listOf("off", "auto")) initialSubtitles else "language")
  }
  var language by rememberSaveable {
    mutableStateOf(if (subtitleMode == "language") initialSubtitles else "")
  }
  val validHeight = (!custom && height == NATIVE_QUALITY) || (height.toIntOrNull() ?: 0) >= 2
  val validLanguage =
    subtitleMode != "language" ||
      Regex("^[a-z]{2,3}$").matches(language.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT))
  GlassSheet(dismiss) {
    Column(
      Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
        .imePadding()
        .padding(horizontal = 24.dp)
        .padding(bottom = 24.dp),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
    ) {
      Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
        Text(
          stringResource(R.string.playback_settings),
          style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        )
        IconButton(onClick = dismiss, modifier = Modifier.glassMaterial(RoundedCornerShape(50))) {
          CastIcon(R.drawable.ic_close, stringResource(R.string.close))
        }
      }
      Text(stringResource(R.string.quality), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
      GlassChoice(
        !custom && height == NATIVE_QUALITY,
        {
          custom = false
          height = NATIVE_QUALITY
        },
        label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.quality_native)) },
      )
      FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        presets.forEach { preset ->
          GlassChoice(
            !custom && height == preset,
            {
              custom = false
              height = preset
            },
            label = { Text("${preset}p") },
          )
        }
        GlassChoice(
          custom,
          {
            custom = true
            if (height == NATIVE_QUALITY) height = ""
          },
          label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.custom)) },
        )
      }
      if (custom)
        OutlinedTextField(
          height,
          { height = it },
          label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.height_pixels)) },
          isError = !validHeight,
          supportingText = { if (!validHeight) Text(stringResource(R.string.height_invalid)) },
          keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
          singleLine = true,
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().glassMaterial(MaterialTheme.shapes.medium),
          shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.medium,
          colors = glassFieldColors(),
        )
      Text(
        stringResource(
          if (!custom && height == NATIVE_QUALITY) R.string.quality_native_help
          else R.string.quality_help
        ),
        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
      )
      HorizontalDivider()
      Text(stringResource(R.string.subtitles), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
      FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        listOf(
            "off" to R.string.subtitles_off,
            "auto" to R.string.subtitles_auto,
            "language" to R.string.subtitles_language,
          )
          .forEach { (value, label) ->
            GlassChoice(
              subtitleMode == value,
              { subtitleMode = value },
              label = { Text(stringResource(label)) },
            )
          }
      }
      if (subtitleMode == "language")
        OutlinedTextField(
          language,
          { language = it },
          label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.language_code)) },
          isError = !validLanguage,
          supportingText = { if (!validLanguage) Text(stringResource(R.string.language_invalid)) },
          singleLine = true,
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().glassMaterial(MaterialTheme.shapes.medium),
          shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.medium,
          colors = glassFieldColors(),
        )
      if (subtitleMode != "off")
        Text(
          stringResource(R.string.subtitles_help),
          style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
          color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        )
      GlassButton(
        prominent = true,
        onClick = {
          save(
            height,
            if (subtitleMode == "language") language.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            else subtitleMode,
          )
        },
        enabled = validHeight && validLanguage,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 52.dp),
      ) {
        Text(stringResource(R.string.done))
      }
    }
  }
}

components.name: App appearance
components.description: Exact native Compose themeLabel, AppThemePicker and shared AppChoiceRow source sections from android/app/src/main/java/io/github/stupside/castor/ui/main/CastingSheets.kt. AppTheme and CastOptions own the saved System/Light/Dark policy; Dark is the default. Source preview, not an HTML control.
components.html:
internal fun themeLabel(theme: AppTheme): Int =
  when (theme) {
    AppTheme.System -> R.string.theme_system
    AppTheme.Light -> R.string.theme_light
    AppTheme.Dark -> R.string.theme_dark
  }

@Composable
internal fun AppThemePicker(
  selected: AppTheme,
  dismiss: () -> Unit,
  select: (AppTheme) -> Unit,
) {
  GlassSheet(dismiss) {
    Column(
      Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
        .padding(horizontal = 24.dp)
        .padding(bottom = 28.dp),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(18.dp),
    ) {
      Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
        Text(
          stringResource(R.string.appearance),
          style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        )
        IconButton(onClick = dismiss, modifier = Modifier.glassMaterial(RoundedCornerShape(50))) {
          CastIcon(R.drawable.ic_close, stringResource(R.string.close))
        }
      }
      Text(
        stringResource(R.string.appearance_help),
        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
      )
      Column(Modifier.selectableGroup(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
        AppTheme.entries.forEach { theme ->
          AppChoiceRow(
            selected == theme,
            stringResource(themeLabel(theme)),
            if (theme == AppTheme.Dark) stringResource(R.string.theme_default) else null,
          ) {
            select(theme)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun AppChoiceRow(chosen: Boolean, label: String, detail: String?, select: () -> Unit) {
  Row(
    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
      .glassMaterial(MaterialTheme.shapes.medium, chosen)
      .selectable(chosen, role = Role.RadioButton, onClick = select)
      .heightIn(min = 76.dp)
      .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 16.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
  ) {
    CompositionLocalProvider(
      LocalContentColor provides
        if (chosen) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
    ) {
      Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
        Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge)
        detail?.let {
          Text(
            it,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
            color =
              if (chosen) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary
              else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
          )
        }
      }
      if (chosen) CastIcon(R.drawable.ic_check)
    }
  }
}

narrative.overview:
Castor's native Android interface places clear, translucent controls over a continuous aqua, blue and warm-sand scenic field. Light-catching rims and a restrained sheen give the panels depth; petrol accents identify the primary action and selected choices. Text and icons stay sharp. Dark mode uses its own deep teal and blue ground with warm sand beneath the glass.

This is an operating interface: the link, television and next action remain easy to find. The material follows the user's explicit Liquid Glass replacement request, including language and appearance selection, while Material 3 owns native interaction. The scope is `android/`; the desktop interface has its own system. The Castor name, original beaver vector and vector interface icons remain the identity.
keyCharacteristics: One scenic glass material across main content, fields, choices, sheets, status and recovery.
Sharp native sans typography above a scenic-only blur layer.
Dark by default, with saved System, Light and Dark choices, petrol emphasis and visible selection.
Scrollable task content and focused sheets above a reachable casting or stop action.
Immediate, saved English or Italian choice through wide checkmarked language rows.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Resolve foregrounds from the current Material scheme; accent glass uses on-primary and ordinary panels use on-surface. Check readable text against the composed scenic ground as well as the panel tint.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Use the implemented Material role hierarchy and scalable sp units. Keep foreground text out of the blurred graphics layer.

rules.name: The Scenic-Only Blur Rule
rules.body: Record and blur only the scenic backplate. Keep text, controls and media content sharp, and retain the translucent fallback on API 28–30.

dos: Do treat Glass.kt, Theme.kt and Type.kt as the source of truth for shared material, both palettes and native typography.
Do retain native Material interaction, radio selection semantics, visible press feedback, Android Back, IME handling and scalable text.
Do keep the primary casting or stop action reachable while task content and focused sheets scroll.
Do keep English and Italian resources and apply saved language and appearance choices immediately without losing the draft or running service.
Do preserve the Castor name, original beaver vector, vector interface icons and actual active-cast metadata.
donts: Don't blur foreground text, controls or embedded media content to produce the glass material.
Don't reintroduce the superseded opaque Laguna material or language AlertDialog into the shared app surfaces.
Don't invent pause, seek, playback-position or volume controls beyond the current casting RPCs.
Don't present a new draft or saved receiver preference as the source or receiver of an existing cast.
Don't infer physical-device performance, television playback or final visual approval from emulator screenshots or code documentation.
